items.problem: Project/root-namespace name equal to a WinRT type name (project 'KeyCredentialManager' == Windows.Security.Credentials.KeyCredentialManager) makes unqualified static calls fail with CS0234 and triggers a cascading WMC1509/WMC9999 XAML internal error. The skill covered neither this collision nor the WMC9999 cascade.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 39-50 (5x CS0234 'does not exist in the namespace KeyCredentialManager'); build-output 'Xaml Internal Error error WMC9999'; agent quote 'our project is named KeyCredentialManager which conflicts with Windows.Security.Credentials.KeyCredentialManager'. lessons.json/skill-defects.json.
items.root_cause: Root namespace equals the WinRT class name; identifier resolves to the app namespace instead of the WinRT type. WMC9999 is a downstream cascade of the failed C# pass.
items.change: Added a new subsection 'CS0234 … does not exist in the namespace <YourProjectName> (project name collides with a WinRT type)' under 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite', with the alias/fully-qualify/global:: fixes, an anchor {#project-name-collision}, and an explicit note that WMC1509/WMC9999 is a cascade not a XAML bug and that renaming the project is the wrong fix.
items.expected_effect: On the next API-named-sample migration the agent recognises CS0234-into-own-namespace immediately and applies the alias fix instead of spending ~10 turns, and does not chase WMC9999 as a separate XAML defect.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of an API-named sample, the build-fix loop resolves CS0234 in <=2 edit turns and no turns are spent investigating WMC9999 in isolation.

items.problem: When the build fails with CS0234 into the project's own namespace, the validator only printed a generic 'Common build errors' pointer, leaving the agent to infer the name collision itself.
items.evidence: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 lines 507-518 (generic hint only); dev-agent reasoned out the collision manually (session-log turns 39-50).
items.root_cause: Validator did not exploit the machine-detectable signal that the CS0234 namespace token equals the project base name.
items.change: Added a targeted [HINT] in the build-fail branch: if any distinct CS0234 error's namespace token equals [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($csproj), print a pointer to PATTERNS.md#project-name-collision and note WMC1509/WMC9999 is a cascade.
items.expected_effect: The validator names the root cause (project-name/WinRT-type collision) directly whenever it occurs, so the agent goes straight to the alias fix.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-running the validator against a project that has this collision prints the '[HINT] CS0234 into namespace <name> = your project name collides with a WinRT type' line; projects without the collision do not.

deferred_to_human: Tier-0 (harness/scaffold): the WinUI screenshot rendered blank in the non-interactive scoring session because swapchain/DesktopChildSiteBridge content cannot be composited by PrintWindow/CopyFromScreen. This is an eval-environment capture limitation, not a migration defect, and is out of scope for the migration skill.
